verdict.rationale: Docs show `hatchet worker dev` for running a worker locally with auto-reload and mention an 'Embedded Mode' page, which partially supports a lightweight local run, but there is no evidence of a single command spinning up the full engine (control plane) locally, nor any documented unit-testing utilities, time-skipping, or step mocking for workflows. Missing for 10: dedicated single-command full-engine local runner, workflow unit-testing framework, time-skipping/mocked-step utilities, and any independent confirmation of these testing features.
